what.text: This page follows Venezuelans in Bolivia whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 8259 people in this group in Bolivia, 0.1% of all Venezuelans in it.
The largest numbers of Venezuelan refugees live in Spain, Brazil, the United States and Mexico.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Venezuela, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's figures for this group start in 2019 at 5472.
The figure reached its highest point, 18475, at the end of 2024 and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Bolivia.
These are year-end totals for Bolivia only, and the group is never added to refugees.
